scientific_integrity: Proof analytic for all admissible graphs and times; finite checks not treated as complete proof. No independent audit or validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected noncomplete triangle-free strongly regular graphs with 1≤μ<k, unweighted unnormalized Laplacian; the strong shape-only positivity time result has earlier general coverage. Historical originality of exact endpoint norm subject to independent review. The included numerical checks are illustrative.
title: Exact transient maximum-norm amplification for graph bi-Laplacians on triangle-free strongly regular graphs
